card.name: Adjectives before variability between patients
card.fires_on: Size or scope words like large, wide, marked, much or individual, placed right before variability or differences between patients. Seen in drug-label passages on dose and clearance.

modes.label: Size adjective
modes.description: Large, wide or marked right before variability or differences.

modes.label: Individual or inter- word
modes.description: The word individual or patient just before variability.
modes.example: Because there was much<< individual>> variability in clearance between patients with renal impairment

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict variability, variation or fluctuations as the next word.
card.plain: It spots wording that is about to say drug levels vary a lot from one person to another.
